instruction: Add 'manager@outlook.com' as a BCC recipient to the email draft, and keep the compose window open.

command: import os; import re; profile_dir = os.path.expanduser('~/.thunderbird'); profiles = [d for d in os.listdir(profile_dir) if d.endswith('.default')]; draft_file = os.path.join(profile_dir, profiles[0], 'ImapMail/outlook.office365.com/Drafts') if profiles else None; content = open(draft_file, 'r', errors='ignore').read() if draft_file and os.path.exists(draft_file) else ''; bcc_fields = re.findall(r'^Bcc: (.+)$', content, re.MULTILINE); print('BCC added!' if any('manager@outlook.com' in b for b in bcc_fields) else 'BCC not added')
